post.description: Redeems an Arena activation code for the signed-in player. The official client opens the activation dialog when `POST /api/arena/status` fails with `activation needed`, posts the entered `code`, closes the dialog on success and retries the status update. A logical failure `invalid code` is shown as "Activation code is invalid"; other errors as "Unknown error".

200.description: Success, or a logical error in the HTTP 200 `{error}` envelope.

post.x-unverified: The success body is not read by the official client; only the `invalid code` error string is evidenced.

200.description: Success, or a logical error in the HTTP 200 `{error}` envelope.

get.x-unverified: Whether an anonymous caller receives a room (the lobby calls it when signed out) and response fields other than `room` are not evidenced.

get.description: Resolves a room-history share code (created by `POST /api/game/history-share`, shared as `screeps.com/s/<code>`) for the history room view. Chunks are then read from `GET /api/seasons/replay/{code}/{tick}`.

200.description: Success, or a logical error in the HTTP 200 `{error}` envelope.

get.x-unverified: Value types of `minTime`/`maxTime` (tick numbers) are inferred from use; other fields and authentication requirements are not evidenced.

get.description: Raw room-history chunk of a shared replay, fetched with `$http` (not the Api wrapper, so no `ok` envelope) only when `options.official` is true and a share `code` is present; otherwise the official history host or the private-server `/room-history` is used. `tick` is the chunk base `floor(t / historyChunkSize) * historyChunkSize`. The client requires HTTP 200, fills `room` itself when absent and replays `ticks` like any history chunk; any failure shows an empty replay.

200.description: History chunk without the API envelope.

default.description: Any non-200 status; the official client treats it as a missing chunk.

get.x-unverified: Error status codes and bodies are not evidenced (the client treats every non-200 response as missing); the chunk shape is evidenced only through the shared history-chunk consumer.
